relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: The use of CB2 receptor agonist AM1241 increases the expression of MOR and reduces morphine tolerance

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 receptor agonists inhibit the development of morphine tolerance.

relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: a CB2 receptor agonist inhibited microglial activation and the inflammatory cytokines IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α to attenuate morphine tolerance

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: TLR4 functions as a prime signal that triggers the downstream signaling pathway, enhancing the transcription of NLRP3 and pro IL-1β.

relationships.subject: morphine tolerance
relationships.evidence_quote: Morphine tolerance was related to an increase in the protein expression of TPRV1 in a model of cancer pain

key_findings: Review: CB2 agonists attenuate morphine tolerance, plausibly via MOR upregulation, MAPK/microglia and cytokine suppression.
TLR4-NLRP3 signalling contributes to morphine tolerance.
